title: P3-D spec — training-readiness assessment (assessment ONLY, never training)
status: FROZEN — criteria and thresholds pinned before the assessment runs. No change after the verdict.
objective: Determine whether AIQ-VeriClave has enough evidence to justify FUTURE SFT/training. This track produces a verdict, never a model.

no_training_guardrail.rule: HARD. No training, fine-tuning, LoRA, RL, distillation, tokenizer training, or training-data formatting (no .jsonl/.parquet training shards, no prompt/completion pairing for trainers) may occur in this track. The assessor reads frozen evidence artifacts and writes one assessment JSON. Violation rejects the track regardless of the verdict.
no_training_guardrail.enforcement: regression tests in test_p3_readiness_v2.py assert the assessor imports no training libraries and writes only P3_D_READINESS_V2.json

decision_tree: P3-C PASS -> P3-D assessment -> READY (training may be authorized SEPARATELY via a P4 authorization, never here) | NOT READY (improve dataset/harness, then reassess) | BLOCKED (required evidence cannot currently be measured). P3-C PASS does NOT authorize training.

verdict_categories.READY: evidence supports a controlled training experiment (all dimensions PASS)
verdict_categories.BLOCKED: required evidence cannot currently be measured (any dimension UNMEASURABLE)

anti_rule: P3-D must never use 'dataset exists' as sufficient justification for training. Volume without balance, diversity, labels, held-out separation, and economics is NOT READY.

d1_scale.question: Dataset scale — current corpus vs required training scale
d1_scale.why: SFT/LoRA needs ~10^3-10^4 positives; below 1000 there is no training-scale claim

d2_diversity.question: Diversity — RTL blocks, requirements, bug types, verification tasks
d2_diversity.pass: >= 3 task families AND >= 2 design families with >= 1 REAL (non-synthetic) family
d2_diversity.why: 2 synthetic task families cannot support generalization claims

d3_balance.question: Success/failure balance — high-quality positive AND negative trajectories
d3_balance.pass: positives >= 100 AND positives >= 20% of labeled generations
d3_balance.why: a drowned-positive corpus teaches failure, not repair

d4_labels.question: Verifier labels — machine-verifiable PASS/FAIL/UNPROVEN evidence
d4_labels.pass: 100% of scored generations carry deterministic verifier labels; 0 human-graded and 0 model-graded labels
d4_labels.why: training labels must be machine-checkable, not opinion

d5_failure_modes.question: Failure-mode coverage — T4/R2/R5 and other capability walls represented
d5_failure_modes.pass: full trajectories exist for the T4 wall AND the R2 wall AND >= 1 further wall/family (e.g. R5)
d5_failure_modes.why: training must see every wall it is expected to climb

d6_trajectories.question: Trajectory quality — generation, verification, repair, closure logged
d6_trajectories.pass: >= 95% of generations log prompt + verbatim output + verdict + latency/tokens, AND multi-round repair histories exist
d6_trajectories.why: SFT needs complete trajectories, not bare answers

d7_contamination.question: Contamination control — clean provenance of prompts and outputs
d7_contamination.pass: all prompts repo-authored AND all outputs freshly generated (no external text)
d7_contamination.why: memorized text is not evidence of capability

d8_heldout.question: Held-out evaluation readiness — genuinely unseen IP/tasks with a frozen split
d8_heldout.pass: a frozen held-out split exists, disjoint from every training-eligible case, scored only by frozen verifiers
d8_heldout.why: without held-out separation, leakage cannot be proven absent and no training claim is measurable

d9_provenance.question: Data provenance/versioning — reproducible dataset construction
d9_provenance.pass: every trajectory traceable to (source artifact, commit/tag, model id, verifier)
d9_provenance.why: an unreproducible dataset is not an asset

d10_economics.question: Training economics — evidence justifies GPU/training expenditure
d10_economics.pass: a recorded cost/benefit memo shows expected value (capability gain x generality) exceeds GPU spend at current scale
d10_economics.why: training without a positive-EV case is expenditure without justification

verdict_rule: READY iff all 10 dimensions PASS. NOT READY if any dimension FAILs. BLOCKED if any dimension is UNMEASURABLE (required source artifact missing or unreadable). Dimension grades are computed, not asserted, by scripts/p3d_readiness_v2.py from frozen artifacts only (no model calls, no network).
